decisions.hidden_reasoning:
We need to choose 3 Pokémon for team preview. Opponent has Garchomp, Dragapult, Kommo-o, Hydreigon, Gliscor, Milotic. Need to pick a strong core.

Glimmora with Focus Sash can set up Stealth Rock/Spikes and Toxic Debris, good lead. Gholdengo blocks Defog and is strong special attacker. Dragonite with Multiscale + DD is a good win condition. Kingambit is strong but slow. Garganacl is defensive. Annihilape is bulky.

Opponent has many Dragons - Garchomp, Dragapult, Kommo-o, Hydreigon, plus Gliscor and Milotic. Fairy would be great but we don't have one. We have Gholdengo (Steel/Ghost) which resists Dragon. Dragonite with Multiscale and Ice Spinner can hit Dragons. Glimmora has Rock moves.

I'd bring Glimmora as lead for hazards + Toxic Debris, Gholdengo for special offense and blocking hazard removal, and Dragonite as win condition with DD + Extreme Speed. Kingambit could be good with Sucker Punch but slow. 

Actually Dragonite with Ice Spinner is great against Garchomp, Dragapult (if it switches in), Kommo-o, Hydreigon. Gholdengo's Make It Rain is strong. Glimmora can set hazards and Mortal Spin.

Let me consider: opponent likely leads with Garchomp or Gliscor. Glimmora's Focus Sash lets it survive and set hazards. Earth Power hits Garchomp? Garchomp is Dragon/Ground, Earth Power is Ground - no effect on Flying? Garchomp is not Flying. Earth Power hits Garchomp neutrally? Ground vs Dragon/Ground - Ground is 1x on Dragon, 1x on Ground? Ground vs Ground is 1x. So neutral.

Glimmora's Mortal Spin is Poison physical - weak but clears hazards. Stealth Rock is great against their team.

I'll go with Glimmora, Gholdengo, Dragonite.

Actually, Kingambit with Sucker Punch could be good against Dragapult, but Dragonite is more versatile.

Final: BRING: glimmora, gholdengo, dragonite.
